description: This file contains functions and logic for copying and processing plugin metadata, including handling plugin skill paths, rewriting package extensions, and managing plugin directories for a build process.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites extension entries in package.json to use .js files instead of other extensions.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level public surface files from a plugin directory, filtering out test and config files.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and public surface entries.

methods.name: rewritePackageEntry
methods.description: Rewrites a package entry string to use .js extension.

methods.name: ensurePathInsideRoot
methods.description: Ensures a given path is inside a specified root directory, resolving and validating the path.

methods.name: normalizeManifestRelativePath
methods.description: Normalizes a relative path in a manifest, replacing backslashes with slashes and removing leading ./

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the source path of a declared skill, considering plugin directory and repo root.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target path for a bundled skill, especially handling node_modules paths.

methods.name: isTransientCopyError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a transient copy error based on error code.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous sleep for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: copySkillPathWithRetry
methods.description: Copies a skill path with retries on transient errors.

methods.name: copyDeclaredPluginSkillPaths
methods.description: Copies declared plugin skill paths from source to target directory, handling node_modules and filtering.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main function to copy plugin metadata, process plugin directories, and generate bundled plugin files.
